name: Unilever Israel
description: Israeli subsidiary of Unilever (operating locally since 1938) with ~2,000 staff; brands include Telma, Strauss Ice Cream, Klik, Knorr, Hellmann's, Pinuk, Dove and Badin.

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

notes: Unilever and its brands (Dove, Knorr, Hellmann's, Axe, Pinuk, Badin, Strauss ice cream) appear on McCann TLV's client wall; Great Digital (merged into Reuveni-Pridan's Arlo in 2026) also listed Unilever as a client. Agency as of 2026-08: McCann credited on the Hellmann's campaign (ICE, Aug 2026). Michal Tamari, Unilever Israel VP marketing for ice cream and snacks, moved to Tnuva in 2025 (ICE, Jun 2025); the ice-cream business has since been spun off with The Magnum Ice Cream Company.
